title: Daily Rest: Regular, Reduced & Split
whatItIs: Within 24 hours of the end of your last rest, you must take a daily rest: 11 hours (regular), split 3 + 9 hours, or 9 hours (reduced, up to 3 times between weekly rests).

keyFacts.text: You MUST take a daily rest within each 24 hours after the end of your previous daily or weekly rest.

keyFacts: Regular daily rest: at least 11 continuous hours.
Split daily rest: at least 3 hours, then at least 9 hours: 12 hours in total.
Reduced daily rest: 9 to under 11 hours, up to 3 times between weekly rests.
Work for another employer is never rest.
You may rest in the vehicle only if it is stationary and has suitable sleeping facilities, e.g. a bunk.

visual.caption: Daily rest within 24 hours: legal and illegal patterns

rows.label: Reduced: 9 hours
rows.note: No more than 3 times between weekly rests.

rows.label: Split wrongly: 3 hours, then 8 hours
rows.note: The second part of a split rest must be at least 9 hours.

a.label: Reduced daily rest
points: At least 9 hours in one block
Only 3 times between weekly rests; no compensation needed

b.label: Split daily rest
points: A regular rest: doesn't count towards the 3 reductions

onTheTest.question: Since your last weekly rest you've taken 3 reduced daily rests. What is the shortest daily rest you can take next?
onTheTest.why: A 9-hour reduced rest is allowed only 3 times between weekly rests. Then you need a regular rest: 11 hours, or 3 + 9.

onTheTest.question: You want to split your daily rest into two periods. Which pattern is allowed?
onTheTest.why: The first part must be at least 3 hours and the second at least 9 hours: 12 hours in total.

traps: A split rest totals 12 hours, not 11: at least 3 + at least 9.
Reduced rests: up to 3 times between weekly rests, not 3 times a week.
The 24 hours start when your last rest ended, not at midnight.
